tools.name: create_privacy_policy_url
tools.description: Generate and host a privacy policy for a business, app, store or site and return its stable HTTPS URL. Free resource types and Agent API key holders get liveUrl at once; other types get a Stripe Checkout link ($49/year) for a human to pay, plus the pendingUrl that goes live after payment. Repeating

tools.name: check_privacy_policy_url
tools.description: Confirm whether a hosted privacy policy is live. Returns status (active or not_found), liveUrl, and updatedAt when live.

tools.name: generate_store_privacy_labels
tools.description: Answers for Apple's App Privacy details and Google Play's Data safety form from the SDKs an app uses, their settings and the data the app collects itself. Every answer carries the vendor or store page it comes from. Settings are yes/no questions per SDK (ids like ga.user_id, app.iap); unknown ids ar

tools.name: generate_privacy_manifest
tools.description: Apple privacy manifest for the app's own code: the data the app itself collects (ownData ids), its own tracking (with tracking domains), the required-reason APIs its code uses with Apple's reason codes, and optionally SDKs linked statically without their own manifest. SDKs with their own manifest ar

tools.name: list_resource_types
tools.description: The resourceType values create_privacy_policy_url accepts, and which of them are hosted free. No side effects.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_privacy_policy_url, check_privacy_policy_url, check_a2p_10dlc_documents · Private data: create_privacy_policy_url, check_a2p_10dlc_documents · Public sink: check_a2p_10dlc_documents.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_privacy_policy_url, check_privacy_policy_url, check_a2p_10dlc_documents · Private data: create_privacy_policy_url, check_a2p_10dlc_documents · Public sink: check_a2p_10dlc_documents

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "create_privacy_policy_url" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
